testcase.name: Scenario: Keep the only staged command in place at ordering boundaries: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:546:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Keep the only staged command in place at ordering boundaries ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the Ribbon customization dialog has an initially empty Part Tools custom panel ✔ And the user has staged "2D Sketches" as the only command ✔ When the user selects "2D Sketches" in the custom panel list ✔ And the user clicks the up ordering button ✔ Then "2D Sketches" remains the only command in the list ✔ When the user clicks the down ordering button ✔ Then "2D Sketches" remains the only command in the list ✔ And the target still indicates a pending change ✔ When the user clicks Cancel ✔ Then the customization dialog closes ✔ And no User Commands panel appears on the Tools ribbon
